title: fix(api): honor the stop parameter on /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions

files.patch:
@@ -21,6 +21,20 @@
 router = APIRouter()
 ai_service = AIService()
 
+
+def _apply_stop(text: str, stop) -> str:
+    """Cut ``text`` at the earliest stop sequence (which is not included), as OpenAI does."""
+    if not stop:
+        return text
+    sequences = [stop] if isinstance(stop, str) else stop
+    cut = len(text)
+    for seq in sequences:
+        if seq:
+            idx = text.find(seq)
+            if idx != -1:
+                cut = min(cut, idx)
+    return text[:cut]
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stop", ["two", ["zzz", "two"]])
+def test_chat_stop_truncates_response(client, stop):
+    body = _body(False)
+    body["stop"] = stop
+    resp = client.post("/v1/chat/completions", json=body)
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    assert resp.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"] == "line one\n\nline "
+

+def test_chat_stop_truncates_stream(client):
+    body = _body(True)
+    body["stop"] = "two"
+    resp = client.post("/v1/chat/completions", json=body)
+    lines = [l[len("data: "):] for l in resp.text.split("\n\n") if l.startswith("data: ")]
+    chunks = [json.loads(l) for l in lines[:-1]]
+    text = "".join(c["choices"][0]["delta"].get("content", "") for c in chunks)
